title: Canonical functor from the DG homotopy quotient to the derived category
statement: For an associative unital differential graded integer algebra $A$, use right DG modules, their quasi-isomorphism localization $Q:\operatorname{Mod}(A,d)\to D(A,d)$ from [def-sfb-dg-derived-category], and the right-linear homotopy relation and quotient $q:\operatorname{Mod}(A,d)\to K(A,d)$ from [def-sfb-dg-homotopy-structure]. The functor $Q$ identifies homotopic DG maps: $f-g=d_Nh+hd_M$ for a right-linear degree-minus-one $h$ implies $Q(f)=Q(g)$. Define $L:K(A,d)\to D(A,d)$ by descending $Q$ along $q$: on objects $L(qM)=Q(M)$, and on a homotopy class $[f]$ its value is $Q(f)$. This is the quotient lift, with fixed object and arrow data, rather than an arbitrary functor between these categories.
